name: create-block/button-hover-colors
title: Button Hover Colors (internal — not a real block)
description: Not a registered block. Exists only so the build pipeline compiles the editor-only script that adds Hover Background Color / Hover Text Color controls to the standard core/button block, enqueued directly by my-custom-block.php in the block editor. See my-custom-block.php for the enqueue.
